title: Minimal-Intervention Prompts for Suppressing Deceptive CoT

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Prompt-level mitigations are immediately deployable without model access. If effective at reducing the 2.1% deceptive reasoning rate, this is a high-leverage, low-cost intervention.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Designing prompt prefixes and measuring deceptive CoT rate requires access to models that exhibit deception. GPT-5 system card methodology may not be directly reproducible by students. Evaluation criteria for deceptive CoT need careful definition.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Designing a library of prompts and measuring their effects on deceptive CoT rate. The ground truth definition is challenging. Feasible if scoped to 5-10 prompt variants on a fixed test set, but evaluation design takes time.
